key_claims: A new framework published in Brain offers an explanation for how the brain creates memories and experiences.
The framework provides insight into how disruptions in memory formation may indicate Alzheimer's disease and other forms of dementia.
limitations: The source does not provide details on empirical study methods, sample sizes, or clinical trial outcomes.
Surrogate clock scores do not measure tissue-specific botanical, anti-inflammatory, joint, enzymatic, or mucosal benefits.
what_not_to_say: This framework is proven to cure Alzheimer's disease or other forms of dementia.
Surrogate clock scores measure tissue-specific botanical, anti-inflammatory, joint, enzymatic, or mucosal benefits.
